name: ReceiptAllocations
technicalDescription: Many-to-many between Receipts and Invoices: how much of a receipt closes each invoice, and on what evidence. Written with the receipt when the person approves the split. The invoice layer (paymentStatus, remainingAmount, paidSeen*) is computed from these rows.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount of this receipt allocated to the invoice

columns.name: openBefore
columns.description: The invoice's open amount before this receipt

columns.name: kind
columns.description: מלאה = closes the invoice; חלקית = leaves a remainder

columns.name: source
columns.description: סכום = ProposeAllocation (oldest first after the debt check), ידני = edited in the allocation editor

columns.name: sourceRef
columns.description: The evidence row: InboundEmails id, CustomerNotes id, or empty; since 05.11 (b/debt-allocation) the approver of an allocation: the person's display name or אושר אוטומטית

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: isPartial
columns.description: Plan 04.11 part B: the invoice is only partly covered by this allocation

columns.name: openAfter
columns.description: The invoice's open amount after this allocation
